entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return a product.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Maria Garcia. Order number is VF98765.

Thank you, Maria. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just hard to use. I expected more from it, but the interface is confusing.
I'm sorry to hear you're finding it difficult. Have you had a chance to look through the user manual that came with it? Sometimes the setup can be a little tricky.
I glanced at it. Whatever. It shouldn't require a novel to figure out. I just want to send it back.
I understand your frustration. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment please...

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked the policy, and since your item was delivered within the last 10 days, you are eligible for a return with a full refund. I can process that for you right now.
Oh. Fine. I guess that works.

Excellent. I have just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off at the post office.
Your refund will be processed 3-5 business days after we receive the item. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Maria?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
